defuss-shadcn / Math / math-renderer

Built with: CSS JS

Formula RenderingATM

Mathematics as TeX. Write the formula into a <code class="math-renderer-source"> inside a .math-renderer; the official KaTeX renderer typesets it into visual HTML plus MathML for screen readers. The component ships no KaTeX code - the first formula on a page loads the pinned build once, a page without one never does. Without JavaScript the TeX reads as code. A notation tree makes single terms selectable, and a table or a legend can link to them.

Upstream

Accessibility

• KaTeX's MathML is what screen readers speak; the visual HTML is aria-hidden

• Term buttons are one tab stop (arrows move, Escape clears) and report aria-pressed

• The selection is outlined and underlined - not color alone; errors are an <output role="alert">

§A display formula

The TeX stays in the code element, hidden once KaTeX typeset it. data-variant='card' puts the formula on a panel; without it, it is plain display math, centered in its column.

×%Studio

§Display and inline

A display formula is a <figure>: centered, and it scrolls sideways instead of overflowing a narrow column. An inline formula is a <span data-variant="inline"> in the sentence, on its baseline.

§Inline in a sentence, then on its own line

×%Studio

§Derivations, matrices and cases

Everything KaTeX supports: aligned derivations, matrices, piecewise definitions, sums and integrals.

§Aligned, matrix, cases

×%Studio

§Selectable terms

A script.math-renderer-notation (JSON) describes the formula as a tree; every node with an id is one selectable occurrence. Click a term - in the formula, on its button or in the table - and all three show it. Terms with a description get a button (one tab stop: arrows move, Enter selects, Escape clears) and the description is announced. A table row, a legend entry or any element with data-math-for and data-math-term is linked to the term. Raw TeX is selectable only as a whole: the component never guesses a term from text.

§A formula and its symbol table, linked

×%Studio

The math-select event (bubbles) carries the selected ids, what they stand for (semanticIds) and their descriptions - a chart, a diagram or a paragraph can follow it. df$.shadcn.mathRenderer.select(el, ids) selects from code.

§Copy as TeX or MathML

df$.shadcn.mathRenderer.export(el, 'latex' | 'mathml') returns the clean TeX - without the term markers - or the MathML KaTeX writes for it.

§Export a formula

×%Studio

§When the TeX is wrong

A formula KaTeX cannot parse keeps its source visible and adds an alert with KaTeX's message. Untrusted commands - \href, \url, \includegraphics, the \html... family - render as unsupported, never as a link or markup.

§A parse error and an untrusted command

×%Studio

§Loading

The first formula on a page imports https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.19.0/dist/katex.mjs and links its stylesheet - pinned, never @latest. To self-host the same build, copy KaTeX's dist/ folder (its fonts sit beside the stylesheet) and point the component at it:

<meta name="math-renderer-module" content="/vendor/katex/katex.mjs" />
<meta name="math-renderer-css" content="/vendor/katex/katex.min.css" />

§States

Named states via the shared State API, bound on each formula:

  • default - the TeX as text (not typeset yet, or reset)
  • rendered - typeset by KaTeX; the source stays in the DOM, hidden
  • highlighted - typeset, with the terms in config.selected marked
  • error - the TeX plus the error message (config.message)

The first example carries data-state-demo; bun run screenshots drives it via el.api.setState(name) and captures screenshots/{mode}/math-renderer-{state}.png.

Machine contract - verified against math-renderer.schema.json by bun run verify:

Import the official KaTeX ESM and link its stylesheet - once per URL. Without arguments: <meta name="math-renderer-module"> / <meta name="math-renderer-css">, else the pinned jsDelivr build. A failed load can be retried (the next call loads again).

Returns Promise<KatexLike> - KaTeX, once the module and its stylesheet have loaded

serialize(tree: MathNotation): MathSerialized
Serialize a notation tree to TeX: clean (what a reader copies) and marked (each term with an id wrapped for selection). Only the tree's own grammar is accepted - single letters or Greek names as symbols, decimal numbers, escaped text, the listed operators - so no TeX command can be injected through it.

§CSS view file

/*
 * Formula Rendering (math-renderer): a formula typeset by KaTeX. The TeX source
 * stays in the DOM - readable code until the typeset output arrives, hidden
 * after. KaTeX's own stylesheet (loaded with it) sets the math fonts and
 * metrics; this sheet places the formula, its states and its term selection.
 */
@layer components {
  .math-renderer {
    display: block;
    margin: 0;
    min-inline-size: 0;
    color: inherit;
    /* the source: readable TeX before (and without) KaTeX */
    & > .math-renderer-source {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
    }
    &[data-state="pending"] > .math-renderer-source {
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    /* KaTeX's output: a display formula scrolls sideways instead of overflowing its column */
    & > .math-renderer-output {
      display: block;
      overflow-x: auto;
      overflow-y: hidden;
      overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
      padding-block: 0.125rem;
    }
    & .katex-display {
      margin: 0.25em 0;
    }
    & > figcaption {
      margin-block-start: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      text-align: center;
    }
    /* selectable terms: a hover outline, the selection outlined and underlined (not color alone) */
    & [data-df-math-id] {
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background-color 120ms ease;
    }
    & [data-df-math-id]:hover {
      outline: 1px dashed var(--ring);
      outline-offset: 1px;
    }
    & [data-df-math-id][data-selected] {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent-foreground);
      outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
      outline-offset: 1px;
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
    }
    /* the term buttons: one tab stop, the pressed term marked */
    & > .math-renderer-terms {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.375rem;
      margin-block-start: 0.75rem;
    }
    & .math-renderer-term {
      appearance: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: var(--background);
      color: var(--foreground);
      padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem;
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      line-height: 1.25rem;
      &:hover {
        background: var(--accent);
        color: var(--accent-foreground);
      }
      &[aria-pressed="true"] {
        border-color: var(--ring);
        background: var(--accent);
        color: var(--accent-foreground);
        text-decoration: underline;
      }
      &:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }
    }
    & > .math-renderer-description {
      display: block;
      margin-block-start: 0.5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      text-align: center;
      &:empty {
        display: none;
      }
    }
    & > .math-renderer-error {
      display: block;
      margin-block-start: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--destructive);
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
    }
    /* card: the formula on a panel (demos, teaching) */
    &[data-variant="card"] {
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--card);
      color: var(--card-foreground);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs);
    }
    /* inline: a formula inside a sentence, on its baseline */
    &[data-variant="inline"] {
      display: inline;
      & > .math-renderer-source {
        display: inline;
        font-size: 0.9em;
      }
      & > .math-renderer-output {
        display: inline;
        overflow: visible;
        padding: 0;
      }
      & > .math-renderer-error {
        display: inline;
        margin-inline-start: 0.375rem;
      }
    }
    /* typeset: the source steps aside - after the variants, so it wins over their display */
    &:is([data-state="rendered"], [data-state="highlighted"]) > .math-renderer-source {
      display: none;
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      & [data-df-math-id] {
        transition: none;
      }
    }
    @media (prefers-contrast: more) {
      & > .math-renderer-source {
        color: var(--foreground);
      }
      & .math-renderer-term {
        border-color: var(--foreground);
      }
    }
    @media (forced-colors: active) {
      & [data-df-math-id][data-selected] {
        outline-color: Highlight;
        background: Highlight;
        color: HighlightText;
      }
      & .math-renderer-term[aria-pressed="true"] {
        border-color: Highlight;
      }
    }
    @media print {
      & > .math-renderer-terms,
      & > .math-renderer-description {
        display: none;
      }
      & > .math-renderer-output {
        overflow: visible;
      }
      & [data-df-math-id][data-selected] {
        background: none;

  states: mathRendererStates,
  mergeConfig: true,
  apply: (el, state) => triggerStateChange(el as HTMLElement, state.name, state.config as MathRendererConfig),
  // reflect reality: the source, the selection and a failure's message as shown
  read: (el, state) => ({

// -- public API ---------------------------------------------------------------
const formula = (el: HTMLElement | string): HTMLElement => {
  const node = (typeof el === 'string' ? dfDollar(el).get(0) : el) as HTMLElement | undefined;
  if (!node?.matches?.('.math-renderer') || !node.api) throw new Error('not an initialized .math-renderer');
  return node;
};
/**
 * Render another source in a formula (the selection is cleared).
 * @param el - the .math-renderer element, or a selector for it
 * @param source - TeX (`{ format: 'latex', text }`) or a notation tree (`{ format: 'notation', tree }`)
 * @returns resolves when the formula is typeset (or shows the error)
 */
function setSource(el: HTMLElement | string, source: MathSource): Promise<void> {
  const node = formula(el);
  return Promise.resolve(mathRendererApi.setState(node, 'rendered', { source, selected: [] }) as Promise<void> | void);
}
/**
 * Select terms of a notation formula - marked in the typeset output, on the term buttons and on linked
 * outside elements; an empty list clears the selection. A `math-select` event reports the change.
 * @param el - the .math-renderer element, or a selector for it
 * @param ids - occurrence ids of the formula's notation tree
 */
function select(el: HTMLElement | string, ids: string[]): void {
  const node = formula(el);
  void mathRendererApi.setState(node, ids.length ? 'highlighted' : 'rendered', { selected: ids });
}
/**
 * A formula as text a reader can copy: its clean TeX (no term markers), or its MathML.
 * @param el - the .math-renderer element, or a selector for it
 * @param format - 'latex' (default) or 'mathml'
 * @returns the TeX, or the MathML markup KaTeX writes for it
 */
async function exportFormula(el: HTMLElement | string, format: 'latex' | 'mathml' = 'latex'): Promise<string> {
  const node = formula(el);
  const source = node._formulaConfig?.source ?? authoredSource(node);
  const { latex } = serialized(source);
  if (format === 'latex') return latex;
  const katex = await load();
  const host = document.createElement('span');
  katex.render(latex, host, { ...katexOptions(node, [], false), output: 'mathml' });

df$.mathRendererApi = mathRendererApi;
df$.mathRendererStates = mathRendererStates;
// public imperative API (AGENTS.md "No window globals": df$.shadcn.mathRenderer)
df$.mathRenderer = { load, serialize, setSource, select, export: exportFormula, url: KATEX_URL };
// -- interaction ----------------------------------------------------------------
/** the formula a click or key event belongs to, and the term it names */
function termTarget(target: EventTarget | null): { el: HTMLElement; id: string } | null {
  if (!(target instanceof Element)) return null;
  const linked = dfDollar(target).closest('[data-math-for][data-math-term]').get(0) as HTMLElement | undefined;
  if (linked) {
    const el = dfDollar(`#${CSS.escape(linked.dataset.mathFor ?? '')}`).get(0) as HTMLElement | undefined;
    return el?.matches('.math-renderer') && el.api ? { el, id: linked.dataset.mathTerm ?? '' } : null;
  }
  const el = dfDollar(target).closest('.math-renderer').get(0) as HTMLElement | undefined;
  if (!el?.api) return null;
  const button = dfDollar(target).closest('.math-renderer-term').get(0) as HTMLElement | undefined;
  if (button) return { el, id: button.dataset.mathTerm ?? '' };
  const term = dfDollar(target).closest('.math-renderer-output [data-df-math-id]').get(0) as HTMLElement | undefined;
  return term ? { el, id: term.dataset.dfMathId ?? '' } : null;
}
function bindInteraction(): void {
  if (document.__mathRendererInit) return;
  document.__mathRendererInit = true;
  // a click selects a term - a second click on the selected term clears it
  dfDollar(document).on('click', (e: Event) => {
    const hit = termTarget(e.target);
    if (!hit || !hit.id) return;
    const current = hit.el._formulaConfig?.selected ?? [];
    select(hit.el, current.length === 1 && current[0] === hit.id ? [] : [hit.id]);
  });
  // the term buttons: one tab stop, arrows move, Escape clears
  dfDollar(document).on('keydown', (e: Event) => {
    const ev = e as KeyboardEvent;
    const button =
      ev.target instanceof Element
        ? (dfDollar(ev.target).closest('.math-renderer-term').get(0) as HTMLElement | undefined)
        : undefined;
    if (!button) return;
    const el = dfDollar(button).closest('.math-renderer').get(0) as HTMLElement;
    if (ev.key === 'Escape') {
      select(el, []);
      return;
    }
    const keys = ['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'Home', 'End'];
    if (!keys.includes(ev.key)) return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    const buttons = dfDollar(el).find('.math-renderer-term').toArray() as HTMLElement[];
    const i = buttons.indexOf(button);
    const next =
      ev.key === 'Home'
        ? 0
        : ev.key === 'End'
          ? buttons.length - 1
          : (i + (ev.key === 'ArrowRight' || ev.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1) + buttons.length) % buttons.length;
    buttons.forEach((b, j) => dfDollar(b).attr('tabindex', j === next ? '0' : '-1'));
    buttons[next]?.focus();
  });
}
// -- init --------------------------------------------------------------------
function init(): void {
  (dfDollar('.math-renderer:not([data-init])').toArray() as HTMLElement[]).forEach((el) => {
    el.dataset.init = '';
    if (!codeOf(el)) return;
    bindInteraction();
    let config: Required<MathRendererConfig>;
    try {
      config = checked({ source: authoredSource(el), selected: [] });
    } catch (err) {
      // a malformed notation script or an oversized source: the TeX in the <code> still reads, the alert says why -
      // written directly (a state change would validate the same source again and throw)
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      el._formulaConfig = { source: { format: 'latex', text: codeOf(el)?.textContent ?? '' }, selected: [], message };
      bindComponent(el, mathRendererApi, { name: 'error', config: el._formulaConfig });
      applyMarkup(el, 'error', { message });
      el.dataset.stateName = 'error';
      return;
    }
    el._formulaConfig = config;
    // el.store + el.api (AGENTS.md "State through stores")
    bindComponent(el, mathRendererApi, { name: 'default', config });
    void mathRendererApi.setState(el, 'rendered', config);
  });
}
init();
new MutationObserver(init).observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
